name: sharpps-dotnet
description: .NET tooling knowledge for solutions built on the SharpPS framework: decompiling .NET Framework and .NET Core/5+ DLLs/EXEs back to C# source via the cross-platform ilspycmd CLI, the SharpPS.Shells PowerShell module's pipeline system (registering, running, and runtime-patching named pipelines), and the solution's recurring C#/.NET design patterns (DI auto-discovery, storage providers, pipeline processors, and the ASP.NET Core plugin-host bootstrap that wires them all up).
